translation: The blessed Lord said: This, verily the profoundest secret, Gnana with Vignana, I shall declare to thee, the uncarping; which, having known, thou shalt be freed from evil. V. The profoundest secret: that which is to be very carefully kept from the unworthy. Gnana: what ought to be known, Vignana: what ought to be known more fully. The uncarping: one that is free from Jealousy and other evil tendencies. This attribute is intended to define those that are worthy of sacred trust to be reposed in them.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . idaM tu te guhyatamaM pravakShyAmyanasUyave . j~nAnaM vij~nAnasahitaM yajj~nAtvA mokShyase.ashubhAt .. 9-1 ..

sanskrit: राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् । प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ॥ ९-२ ॥
translation: Kingly knowledge, kingly secret, hallowed and excellent, this by which the Ruler of the senses is known, which goes unfailingly to the supporter, which is very easy to achieve and is undecaying. (I shall tell thee). V. This: that which will be presently expounded. Kingly knowledge: the most important kind of knowledge: of all. Kingly secret: the secret of secrets than which there is nothing else to be carefully guarded. Hallowed: capable of purifying other things!; hence it is excellent. Pratyaksha: he who stands in every organ of sense and rules it. Prati - every; Aksha: organ of sense). It is the lord who guides every organ of sense from within is Pratyaksha. Avagama: that by which anything is known. So Pratyakshâvagama = the means by which the Ruler of the senses is realised. Dharmya: pertaining to Dharma, the means of knowing Dharma; the Supporter, the Supreme Lord; (from the root Dhuri: to support; Dharma is a derivative denoting agent). Undecaying: of undecaying consequence or fruit. Such is the instruction to be given in the sequel.
itrans: rAjavidyA rAjaguhyaM pavitramidamuttamam . pratyakShAvagamaM dharmya.n susukhaM kartumavyayam .. 9-2 ..

sanskrit: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप । अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥ ९-३ ॥
translation: Those that are without faith in this knowledge relating to Dharma (the supporter, the Lord), O slayer of foes, do not come to Me and only remain fixed in the path of birth and death.
itrans: ashraddadhAnAH puruShA dharmasyAsya parantapa . aprApya mA.n nivartante mR^ityusa.nsAravartmani .. 9-3 ..

sanskrit: मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना । मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥ ९-४ ॥
translation: All this world is pervaded by Me of unmanifest person; all beings stand on me; I do not stand on them. V. This world: consisting of beings moving and unmoving. Pervading everything the Lord might be expected to fall within the perception of all; but He does not. Why? He pervades in his unmanifest form. When we speak of pervasion, we might commit a mistake in thinking that the world is a support or receptacle for the Lord. To prevent it the Lord say, 'All beings, &c.' He is the support of all, whereas He does not rest on the support of anything else.
itrans: mayA tatamidaM sarva.n jagadavyaktamUrtinA . matsthAni sarvabhUtAni na chAhaM teShvavasthitaH .. 9-4 ..

sanskrit: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् । भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥ ९-५ ॥
translation: Moreover, the beings are not resting on Me; note My Lordly power; My Self the Creator of beings is the bearer of beings but does not rest on the beings.
itrans: na cha matsthAni bhUtAni pashya me yogamaishvaram . bhUtabhR^inna cha bhUtastho mamAtmA bhUtabhAvanaH .. 9-5 ..

sanskrit: यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् । तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥ ९-६ ॥
translation: As the great Vayu always abiding in the sky is present everywhere, so do all beings abide in Me; thus, do thou understand.
itrans: yathAkAshasthito nitya.n vAyuH sarvatrago mahAn . tathA sarvANi bhUtAni matsthAnItyupadhAraya .. 9-6 ..

sanskrit: सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् । कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥ ९-७ ॥
translation: During dissolution, all beings, Kaunteya, go into Prakriti who is Mine; at the beginning of Kalpa, I again bring them out in various forms.
itrans: sarvabhUtAni kaunteya prakR^iti.n yAnti mAmikAm . kalpakShaye punastAni kalpAdau visR^ijAmyaham .. 9-7 ..

sanskrit: प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः । भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥ ९-८ ॥
translation: Making use of My own Prakriti, I again and again bring out the whole of this multitude of beings which are under the power of Prakriti.
itrans: prakR^iti.n svAmavaShTabhya visR^ijAmi punaH punaH . bhUtagrAmamimaM kR^itsnamavashaM prakR^itervashAt .. 9-8 ..

sanskrit: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय । उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥ ९-९ ॥
translation: And those acts do not bind Me 'down, O Dhananjaya, ---Me who sit as if indifferent, unattached to those acts.
itrans: na cha mA.n tAni karmANi nibadhnanti dhana~njaya . udAsInavadAsInamasakta.n teShu karmasu .. 9-9 ..

sanskrit: मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् । हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥ ९-१० ॥
translation: By Me directly supervising, Prakriti is made to produce (produces) the moving and unmoving; because of this, O Kaunteya, the world variously comes round and round.
itrans: mayAdhyakSheNa prakR^itiH sUyate sacharAcharam . hetunAnena kaunteya jagadviparivartate .. 9-10 ..

sanskrit: अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् । परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥ ९-११ ॥
translation: The deluded souls neglect Me as having assumed human form, not knowing My true nature, Supreme eternal, great and perfect.
itrans: avajAnanti mAM mUDhA mAnuShI.n tanumAshritam . paraM bhAvamajAnanto mama bhUtamaheshvaram .. 9-11 ..

sanskrit: मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः । राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥ ९-१२ ॥
translation: They are of empty 'hopes; of empty deeds; of empty knowledge; of perverse understanding; and they have come to be of the deceitful nature of Rakshasas and Asuras.
itrans: moghAshA moghakarmANo moghaj~nAnA vichetasaH . rAkShasImAsurI.n chaiva prakR^itiM mohinI.n shritAH .. 9-12 ..

sanskrit: महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः । भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥ ९-१३ ॥
translation: But the Mahatmas, Partha, having divine nature know Me the cause of beings, and the undecaying, worship Me with the mind that is not given to other things.
itrans: mahAtmAnastu mAM pArtha daivIM prakR^itimAshritAH . bhajantyananyamanaso j~nAtvA bhUtAdimavyayam .. 9-13 ..

sanskrit: सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः । नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥ ९-१४ ॥
translation: Always praising Me, exerting themselves (in glorifying Me), firm in vows, worshipping Me with devotion, ever practising Yoga, they meditate on Me.
itrans: satataM kIrtayanto mA.n yatantashcha dR^iDhavratAH . namasyantashcha mAM bhaktyA nityayuktA upAsate .. 9-14 ..

sanskrit: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते । एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥ ९-१५ ॥
translation: And worshipping by Gnanayagna some others also meditate on Me of the omnipresent form as one, as different, in various ways.
itrans: j~nAnayaj~nena chApyanye yajanto mAmupAsate . ekatvena pR^ithaktvena bahudhA vishvatomukham .. 9-15 ..

sanskrit: अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् । मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥ ९-१६ ॥
translation: I, the Kratu; I, the Yagna; Swadha am I: I am the herb; I, the sacred text; I also the butter; I am the fire; I, the offering.
itrans: ahaM kraturahaM yaj~naH svadhAhamahamauShadham . mantro.ahamahamevAjyamahamagnirahaM hutam .. 9-16 ..

sanskrit: पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः । वेद्यं पवित्रमोङ्कार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ॥ ९-१७ ॥
translation: Of this world I am the father, the mother, the nourisher and the venerable; the one to be known, the holy thing, the sacred syllable, and also the Rik, Sama and Yajus.
itrans: pitAhamasya jagato mAtA dhAtA pitAmahaH . vedyaM pavitramo~NkAra R^iksAma yajureva cha .. 9-17 ..

sanskrit: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् । प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥ ९-१८ ॥
translation: I am the goal, the Lord, master, witness, abode, refuge, well-wisher, origin, dissolution, foundation, treasure-house, seed; the unmodified.
itrans: gatirbhartA prabhuH sAkShI nivAsaH sharaNa.n suhR^it . prabhavaH pralayaH sthAnaM nidhAnaM bIjamavyayam .. 9-18 ..

sanskrit: तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च । अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥ ९-१९ ॥
translation: I give heat (from the sun); (from within the clouds) I hold back and send forth rain, (abiding in the organs of sense and supporting life) I am Amrita or immortality, and also death (as destroying beings); I am Sat as well as Asat, O Arjuna.
itrans: tapAmyahamahaM varSha.n nigR^ihNAmyutsR^ijAmi cha . amR^ita.n chaiva mR^ityushcha sadasachchAhamarjuna .. 9-19 ..

sanskrit: त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा        यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते । ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-        मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥ ९-२० ॥
translation: The Traividyas who drink the juice of Soma and are thereby purified from sin, having performed sacrifices, pray to Me for the goal of Svarga; having ascended the happy abode of the Ruler of the gods, they enjoy the celestial pleasures in the celestial region.
itrans: traividyA mA.n somapAH pUtapApA        yaj~nairiShTvA svargatiM prArthayante . te puNyamAsAdya surendraloka-        mashnanti divyAndivi devabhogAn .. 9-20 ..

sanskrit: ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं        क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति । एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना        गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥ ९-२१ ॥
translation: Having enjoyed that vast region of Svarga, their merit getting diminished, they enter (come back to) the mortal world, again thus striking into the same path of the duties of the three Vedas, desiring enjoyments they attain (to the reward of going and coming back).
itrans: te taM bhuktvA svargalokaM vishAlaM        kShINe puNye martyalokaM vishanti . evaM trayIdharmamanuprapannA        gatAgataM kAmakAmA labhante .. 9-21 ..

sanskrit: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते । तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥ ९-२२ ॥
translation: Those men who devoutly worship Me, thinking of no other of those who are ever devoted to Me! (bear) look after the Yoga and Kshema.
itrans: ananyAshchintayanto mA.n ye janAH paryupAsate . teShA.n nityAbhiyuktAnA.n yogakShemaM vahAmyaham .. 9-22 ..

sanskrit: येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः । तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥ ९-२३ ॥
translation: Also, those who are the volaries of the other gods and worship them with faith—even they, O Kaunteya, Worship Me alone, though not as the Sâstra requires.
itrans: ye.apyanyadevatA bhaktA yajante shraddhayAnvitAH . te.api mAmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipUrvakam .. 9-23 ..

sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च । न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ॥ ९-२४ ॥
translation: I am indeed of all the sacrifices the enjoyer and also the Lord; but they do not thoroughly and truly know Me; and hence they fall.
itrans: ahaM hi sarvayaj~nAnAM bhoktA cha prabhureva cha . na tu mAmabhijAnanti tattvenAtashchyavanti te .. 9-24 ..

sanskrit: यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः । भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥ ९-२५ ॥
translation: Those that worship the gods go to the gods; to Pitris, go the Worshippers of Pitris; they who worship the Bhûtas (such as Saptamatri, &c.,) go to the Bhûtas; so also, My Worshippers come unto Me.
itrans: yAnti devavratA devAnpitR^InyAnti pitR^ivratAH . bhUtAni yAnti bhUtejyA yAnti madyAjino.api mAm .. 9-25 ..

sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति । तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥ ९-२६ ॥
translation: He who offers to Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, water, that devout offering of him whose mind is restrained, I accept.
itrans: patraM puShpaM phalaM toyaM yo me bhaktyA prayachChati . tadahaM bhaktyupahR^itamashnAmi prayatAtmanaH .. 9-26 ..

sanskrit: यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् । यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥ ९-२७ ॥
translation: Whatsoever thou dost, whatsoever thou eatest, whatsoever thou offerest into the fire, whatsoever thou givest; whatsoever thou practisest as austerity, O Kunti's son, that do thou resign to Me.
itrans: yatkaroShi yadashnAsi yajjuhoShi dadAsi yat . yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruShva madarpaNam .. 9-27 ..

sanskrit: शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः । संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ॥ ९-२८ ॥
translation: Thus, thou shalt be freed from the bonds of Karma yielding good and evil fruits; having united in thyself the Sanyasa and Yoga, thou shalt, being released, come unto Me. (29) V. Sanyasa is to renounce the fruit of duties and virtuous deeds performed. Yoga is the performance of such duties and virtuous deeds enjoined upon man.
itrans: shubhAshubhaphalairevaM mokShyase karmabandhanaiH . sa.nnyAsayogayuktAtmA vimukto mAmupaiShyasi .. 9-28 ..

sanskrit: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः । ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥ ९-२९ ॥
translation: Equal am I in all beings; for none is hateful, none beloved; but they who worship Me with devotion—they are in Me and in them also am I.
itrans: samo.ahaM sarvabhUteShu na me dveShyo.asti na priyaH . ye bhajanti tu mAM bhaktyA mayi te teShu chApyaham .. 9-29 ..

sanskrit: अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् । साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥ ९-३० ॥
translation: Even if he be highly unrighteous in conduct, but worships Me without turning to another, he should be considered righteous only; for he has conclusively known the truth.
itrans: api chetsudurAchAro bhajate mAmananyabhAk . sAdhureva sa mantavyaH samyagvyavasito hi saH .. 9-30 ..

sanskrit: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति । कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥ ९-३१ ॥
translation: Soon he comes to be of righteous mind and surely attains to eternal Peace (Moksha). O Kunti's son, do thou well understand that My Bhakta (devotee) never perishes.
itrans: kShipraM bhavati dharmAtmA shashvachChAnti.n nigachChati . kaunteya pratijAnIhi na me bhaktaH praNashyati .. 9-31 ..

sanskrit: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः । स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥ ९-३२ ॥
translation: Partha, indeed, even those who are of sinful birth, viz., women, Vaisyas and Sudras—even they, depending upon Me (having devoted themselves to Me), attain to the highest goal.
itrans: mA.n hi pArtha vyapAshritya ye.api syuH pApayonayaH . striyo vaishyAstathA shUdrAste.api yAnti parAM gatim .. 9-32 ..

sanskrit: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा । अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ॥ ९-३३ ॥
translation: How much (rather) then the righteous Brahmanas and devoted princes and saints? Having come into this transient and joyless world, do thou worship Me.
itrans: kiM punarbrAhmaNAH puNyA bhaktA rAjarShayastathA . anityamasukhaM lokamimaM prApya bhajasva mAm .. 9-33 ..

sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु । मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥ ९-३४ ॥
translation: Give thy mind to Me; be thou My devotee; offer thy sacrifices to Me; prostrate thyself before Me; having thus used thy mind and made Me thy goal, thou shalt surely come unto Me.
itrans: manmanA bhava madbhakto madyAjI mA.n namaskuru . mAmevaiShyasi yuktvaivamAtmAnaM matparAyaNaH .. 9-34 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः । यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥ १०-१ ॥
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Once more, O mighty armed, do listen to My excellent word, which, desiring thy good, I shall tell thee who art delighted (with My words.) V. Excellent word: excellent because of describing the glories of God. Thee who art delighted: by this clause the fitness of the pupil to hear and learn is suggested.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . bhUya eva mahAbAho shR^iNu me paramaM vachaH . yatte.ahaM prIyamANAya vakShyAmi hitakAmyayA .. 10-1 ..

sanskrit: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः । अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ॥ १०-२ ॥
translation: Neither the multitudes of the gods nor the great Rishis, know My glory or birth or creation for I am the first (cause of the gods, of the great Rishis, of all.
itrans: na me viduH suragaNAH prabhavaM na maharShayaH . ahamAdirhi devAnAM maharShINA.n cha sarvashaH .. 10-2 ..

sanskrit: यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् । असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ १०-३ ॥
translation: He who knoweth Me to be the Unborn, the Mover, and the Cause, and the great Lord of the world, he is the one among mortals that is not deluded, and the one liberated from all sins.
itrans: yo mAmajamanAdi.n cha vetti lokamaheshvaram . asammUDhaH sa martyeShu sarvapApaiH pramuchyate .. 10-3 ..

sanskrit: बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः । सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥ १०-४ ॥
translation: Buddhi (the inner sense, mind or discrimination) perception, absence of wish to do what is prohibited (or absence of misapprehension), forbearance and forgiveness, truthfulness, restraint of the senses, reposing the mind on the Lord (devotion), pleasure and pain, origination, existence (sustenance), fear and also fearlessness;
itrans: buddhirj~nAnamasammohaH kShamA satya.n damaH shamaH . sukhaM duHkhaM bhavo.abhAvo bhaya.n chAbhayameva cha .. 10-4 ..

sanskrit: अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः । भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥ १०-५ ॥
translation: Harmlessness, equanimity, contentment, piety (austerity), charity, fame, ill-repute; all these various attributes of beings proceed from Me alone.
itrans: ahi.nsA samatA tuShTistapo dAnaM yasho.ayashaH . bhavanti bhAvA bhUtAnAM matta eva pR^ithagvidhAH .. 10-5 ..

sanskrit: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा । मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥ १०-६ ॥
translation: The seven great Rishis of the preceding Manvantara, and the four Manus born of the mind, are born of Me, as also are those who in the world are their children
itrans: maharShayaH sapta pUrve chatvAro manavastathA . madbhAvA mAnasA jAtA yeShA.n loka imAH prajAH .. 10-6 ..

sanskrit: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः । सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ १०-७ ॥
translation: This Vibhuti and Yoga of Mine, he who truly understandeth becomes endowed with unperturbed contemplation; of this there is no doubt.
itrans: etA.n vibhUti.n yoga.n cha mama yo vetti tattvataH . so.avikampena yogena yujyate nAtra sa.nshayaH .. 10-7 ..

sanskrit: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते । इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥ १०-८ ॥
translation: I am the source of everything: from Me everything derives its activity (from Me everything proceeds); having understood this the wise full of devotion worship Me.
itrans: ahaM sarvasya prabhavo mattaH sarvaM pravartate . iti matvA bhajante mAM budhA bhAvasamanvitAH .. 10-8 ..

sanskrit: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् । कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥ १०-९ ॥
translation: With their mind fixed on Me, with their activity directed to Me, imparting (My knowledge to pupils), mutually talking about Me, they are ever contented and delighted.
itrans: machchittA madgataprANA bodhayantaH parasparam . kathayantashcha mA.n nitya.n tuShyanti cha ramanti cha .. 10-9 ..

sanskrit: तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् । ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥ १०-१० ॥
translation: On them who are constantly endeavouring and are worshipping with delight, I bestow that means, viz., knowledge by which they come into Me.
itrans: teShA.n satatayuktAnAM bhajatAM prItipUrvakam . dadAmi buddhiyogaM taM yena mAmupayAnti te .. 10-10 ..

sanskrit: तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः । नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥ १०-११ ॥
translation: Only out of mercy, I standing in their heart, destroy the darkness of Nescience by the refulgent light of wisdom. V. Darkness (Tamas): bonds of misery. Refulgent: by this is indicated the superior virtue of wisdom to pierce through the darkness and destroy it.
itrans: teShAmevAnukampArthamahamaj~nAnajaM tamaH . nAshayAmyAtmabhAvastho j~nAnadIpena bhAsvatA .. 10-11 ..

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् । पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् ॥ १०-१२ ॥
translation: Arjuna said: O Kesava, Thon art the most excellent and perfect being, the most exalted abode; Thee, the most holy, the divine sage Narada as well as Asita, Devala and Vyasa, all the Rishis declare to be the Purusha (perfect in the six attributes), the Eternal (unmodified), the Divine (far-different from the world) the first God, the Unborn, and the Vibhu (the most exalted being assuming multifarious forms), Thou also tellest me the same. (12, 13.)
itrans: arjuna uvAcha . paraM brahma paraM dhAma pavitraM paramaM bhavAn . puruShaM shAshvataM divyamAdidevamajaM vibhum .. 10-12 ..

sanskrit: आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा । असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥ १०-१३ ॥
translation: Arjuna said: O Kesava, Thon art the most excellent and perfect being, the most exalted abode; Thee, the most holy, the divine sage Narada as well as Asita, Devala and Vyasa, all the Rishis declare to be the Purusha (perfect in the six attributes), the Eternal (unmodified), the Divine (far-different from the world) the first God, the Unborn, and the Vibhu (the most exalted being assuming multifarious forms), Thou also tellest me the same.
itrans: AhustvAmR^iShayaH sarve devarShirnAradastathA . asito devalo vyAsaH svaya.n chaiva bravIShi me .. 10-13 ..

sanskrit: सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव । न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥ १०-१४ ॥
translation: O Kesava, all this I believe to be true that Thou tellest me; indeed, neither the gods nor the Danavas know Thy glorious power, O blessed Lord.
itrans: sarvametadR^itaM manye yanmA.n vadasi keshava . na hi te bhagavanvyakti.n vidurdevA na dAnavAH .. 10-14 ..

sanskrit: स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम । भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥ १०-१५ ॥
translation: Thou Thyself knowest Thyself by Thine own? power, O Purushottama, maker of all beings, the ruler of all beings, God of gods, Lord of the world!
itrans: svayamevAtmanAtmAnaM vettha tvaM puruShottama . bhUtabhAvana bhUtesha devadeva jagatpate .. 10-15 ..

sanskrit: वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः । याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ॥ १०-१६ ॥
translation: Pleased be Thou, O Lord, to tell them completely; divine are Thy glories, with which' glories Thou standest pervading all these worlds.
itrans: vaktumarhasyasheSheNa divyA hyAtmavibhUtayaH . yAbhirvibhUtibhirlokAnimA.nstva.n vyApya tiShThasi .. 10-16 ..

sanskrit: कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् । केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥ १०-१७ ॥
translation: How could I understand Thee, O Yogin, though I may, contemplate all the time; in what things and in what aspects art Thou to be contemplated by me, O Lord?
itrans: kathaM vidyAmahaM yogi.nstvA.n sadA parichintayan . keShu keShu cha bhAveShu chintyo.asi bhagavanmayA .. 10-17 ..

sanskrit: विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन । भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥ १०-१८ ॥
translation: Thy, power and glory, O Janardana, repeatedly tell me in detail; for, to me hearing Thy Amrita-like, (speech) there is no satiety.
itrans: vistareNAtmano yogaM vibhUti.n cha janArdana . bhUyaH kathaya tR^iptirhi shR^iNvato nAsti me.amR^itam .. 10-18 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः । प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥ १०-१९ ॥
translation: Gladly I will tell thee; indeed, the most excellent are My glories; I shall tell such as are important, О the foremost of Kurus; there is no limit to the extent of My glories.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . hanta te kathayiShyAmi divyA hyAtmavibhUtayaH . prAdhAnyataH kurushreShTha nAstyanto vistarasya me .. 10-19 ..

sanskrit: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः । अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥ १०-२० ॥
translation: O Gudakesa, I as Atman am present in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning and the middle and also the end of all beings.
itrans: ahamAtmA guDAkesha sarvabhUtAshayasthitaH . ahamAdishcha madhya.n cha bhUtAnAmanta eva cha .. 10-20 ..

sanskrit: आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् । मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥ १०-२१ ॥
translation: Of the (twelve) Adityas I am Vishnu; of luminaries I am the radiant Sun; I am Marichi of the Maruts (forty-nine); among the stars I am the Moon;
itrans: AdityAnAmahaM viShNurjyotiShA.n ravira.nshumAn . marIchirmarutAmasmi nakShatrANAmahaM shashI .. 10-21 ..

sanskrit: वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः । इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ॥ १०-२२ ॥
translation: Of the Vedas I am the Sama Veda; of the gods I am Vasava (Indra); and of the senses I am the Mind (Manas); of living beings I am the Consciousness;
itrans: vedAnA.n sAmavedo.asmi devAnAmasmi vAsavaH . indriyANAM manashchAsmi bhUtAnAmasmi chetanA .. 10-22 ..

sanskrit: रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् । वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ॥ १०-२३ ॥
translation: And of the Rudras I am Sankara; I am Kubera (the lord of wealth) of the Yakshas and Rakshasas; and of the Vasûs I am Pâvaka; of mountains, Meru am I;
itrans: rudrANA.n sha~NkarashchAsmi vittesho yakSharakShasAm . vasUnAM pAvakashchAsmi meruH shikhariNAmaham .. 10-23 ..

sanskrit: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् । सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥ १०-२४ ॥
translation: O Partha, know Me to be Brihaspati the foremost of Purohitás (priests); of generals I am Skanda; of reservoirs of water, I am the Ocean;
itrans: purodhasA.n cha mukhyaM mA.n viddhi pArtha bR^ihaspatim . senAnInAmahaM skandaH sarasAmasmi sAgaraH .. 10-24 ..

sanskrit: महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् । यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥ १०-२५ ॥
itrans: maharShINAM bhR^igurahaM girAmasmyekamakSharam . yaj~nAnA.n japayaj~no.asmi sthAvarANA.n himAlayaH .. 10-25 ..

sanskrit: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः । गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥ १०-२६ ॥
translation: Of the great Rishis, Bhrigu am I; of words I am the one Akshara (syllable); of all the acts of worship I am the worship called Japa (silent repetition of the sacred names, &c.); of the immoveable I am the Himalaya; of all trees I am) Aswattha; and of divine Rishis, Narada ; of Gandharvas, Chitraratha ; of Siddhas, the Muni Kapila.
itrans: ashvatthaH sarvavR^ikShANA.n devarShINA.n cha nAradaH . gandharvANA.n chitrarathaH siddhAnA.n kapilo muniH .. 10-26 ..

sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् । ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥ १०-२७ ॥
translation: Know Me to be Uchaisravas the nectar-born, of all horses; to be Iráwata of lordly elephants; and to be the Lord of men (monarch) among men;
itrans: uchchaiHshravasamashvAnA.n viddhi mAmamR^itodbhavam . airAvataM gajendrANA.n narANA.n cha narAdhipam .. 10-27 ..

sanskrit: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् । प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥ १०-२८ ॥
translation: Of weapons I am Vajra (thunderbolt); of cows, I am Kamadhuk (Kamadhenu that yields anything desired); and I am Kandarpa the great progenitor; of serpents I am Vasuki;
itrans: AyudhAnAmahaM vajra.n dhenUnAmasmi kAmadhuk . prajanashchAsmi kandarpaH sarpANAmasmi vAsukiH .. 10-28 ..

sanskrit: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् । पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥ १०-२९ ॥
translation: And Ananta am I of Nagas (many-headed serpents); Varuna, of the dwellers in water, am I; and of Pitris I am Aryaman;" Yama, of those that govern, am I.
itrans: anantashchAsmi nAgAnA.n varuNo yAdasAmaham . pitR^INAmaryamA chAsmi yamaH sa.nyamatAmaham .. 10-29 ..

sanskrit: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् । मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥ १०-३० ॥
translation: And I am Prahlada of the Daityas; I am Kâla (the omniscient) of all those that know; of Mrigas (beasts) I am Mrigendra (the lord of beasts); and Vainateya I am of birds;
itrans: prahlAdashchAsmi daityAnA.n kAlaH kalayatAmaham . mR^igANA.n cha mR^igendro.ahaM vainateyashcha pakShiNAm .. 10-30 ..

sanskrit: पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् । झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ॥ १०-३१ ॥
translation: And I am Pavana (the purifier) of purifiers; I am Rama among those that bear weapons; and of fishes I am Makara; of streams I am Janhavi (Ganga);
itrans: pavanaH pavatAmasmi rAmaH shastrabhR^itAmaham . jhaShANAM makarashchAsmi srotasAmasmi jAhnavI .. 10-31 ..

sanskrit: सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन । अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥ १०-३२ ॥
translation: Of creations (creatures) I only am the beginning, the end and the middle, Arjuna; of all the branches of knowledge I am the Adhyatma-Vidya; I am the debate of those that debate;
itrans: sargANAmAdirantashcha madhya.n chaivAhamarjuna . adhyAtmavidyA vidyAnA.n vAdaH pravadatAmaham .. 10-32 ..

sanskrit: अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च । अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥ १०-३३ ॥
translation: Of letters I am the letter (अ) A; I am the Copulative of the classes of compounds; I Myself the undecaying Time; I am the supporter facing every direction;
itrans: akSharANAmakAro.asmi dvandvaH sAmAsikasya cha . ahamevAkShayaH kAlo dhAtAhaM vishvatomukhaH .. 10-33 ..

sanskrit: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् । कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥ १०-३४ ॥
translation: And Mrityu the devourer of all am I; and I the origin of all to come; of women I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, fortitude and forgiveness. V. Of women; of the attributes of women spoken of as women.
itrans: mR^ityuH sarvaharashchAhamudbhavashcha bhaviShyatAm . kIrtiH shrIrvAkcha nArINA.n smR^itirmedhA dhR^itiH kShamA .. 10-34 ..

sanskrit: बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् । मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥ १०-३५ ॥
translation: Of the Same hymns also, Brihat saman; Gayațri, of metres am I; of months I am Margasirsha; of seasons, that of flowers (Kusumakara);
itrans: bR^ihatsAma tathA sAmnA.n gAyatrI ChandasAmaham . mAsAnAM mArgashIrSho.ahamR^itUnA.n kusumAkaraH .. 10-35 ..

sanskrit: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् । जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥ १०-३६ ॥
translation: Dyuta (gambling), of cheaters am I; I am the lustre of the lustrous; victory am I; determination I am; the strength of the strong I am
itrans: dyUta.n ChalayatAmasmi tejastejasvinAmaham . jayo.asmi vyavasAyo.asmi sattvaM sattvavatAmaham .. 10-36 ..

sanskrit: वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः । मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥ १०-३७ ॥
translation: Of the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, Dhananjaya; of the sages too, I am Vyasa; of the learned, Usana the learned;
itrans: vR^iShNInA.n vAsudevo.asmi pANDavAnA.n dhana~njayaH . munInAmapyahaM vyAsaH kavInAmushanA kaviH .. 10-37 ..

sanskrit: दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् । मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥ १०-३८ ॥
translation: I am the punishment of the rulers; statesmanship am I of those that seek victory; I am also the silence of secrets; wisdom of the wise am I.
itrans: daNDo damayatAmasmi nItirasmi jigIShatAm . mauna.n chaivAsmi guhyAnA.n j~nAnaM j~nAnavatAmaham .. 10-38 ..

sanskrit: यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन । न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥ १०-३९ ॥
translation: And whatever is the seed (cause) of all beings that too I am, O Arjuna; naught there is that could be without Me—the moving or unmoving thing.
itrans: yachchApi sarvabhUtAnAM bIjaM tadahamarjuna . na tadasti vinA yatsyAnmayA bhUta.n charAcharam .. 10-39 ..

sanskrit: नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप । एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥ १०-४० ॥
translation: There is no limit to My wonderful glories, O Parantapa; this has been declared but by way of instances; and this (the following) extensive description is also given by Me.
itrans: nAnto.asti mama divyAnA.n vibhUtInAM parantapa . eSha tUddeshataH prokto vibhUtervistaro mayA .. 10-40 ..

sanskrit: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा । तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥ १०-४१ ॥
translation: Whatever existence or being is excellent of its kind, splendid, of deep-rooted life, understand that to have come into existence with a spark of Mine.
itrans: yadyadvibhUtimatsattvaM shrImadUrjitameva vA . tattadevAvagachCha tvaM mama tejo.n.ashasambhavam .. 10-41 ..

sanskrit: अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन । विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥ १०-४२ ॥
translation: Or of what advantage is it to the to know this detail, Arjuna; but by a single ray I remain pervading all this world.
itrans: athavA bahunaitena kiM j~nAtena tavArjuna . viShTabhyAhamidaM kR^itsnamekA.nshena sthito jagat .. 10-42 ..

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् । यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ॥ ११-१ ॥
translation: Arjuna said: What word, out of compassion for me, the supreme secret called the Adhyatma, has been spoken by Thee, by that my present delusion is gone. V. Adhyatma: (Atma: the Lord); regarding the Lord; treating of the Lord. Delusion, viz., my false attachment to kinsmen, &c.
itrans: arjuna uvAcha . madanugrahAya paramaM guhyamadhyAtmasa.nj~nitam . yattvayokta.n vachastena moho.ayaM vigato mama .. 11-1 ..

sanskrit: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया । त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ॥ ११-२ ॥
translation:
In fact, from Thee, the origination and dissolution of beings have been heard at length by me, O One that has eyes broad as the lotus leaf; also, Thine undiminishing glory.
A. Praising the Lord's words Arjuna solicits for revelation of the Visvarupa.
itrans: bhavApyayau hi bhUtAnA.n shrutau vistarasho mayA . tvattaH kamalapatrAkSha mAhAtmyamapi chAvyayam .. 11-2 ..

sanskrit: एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर । द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ॥ ११-३ ॥
itrans: evametadyathAttha tvamAtmAnaM parameshvara . draShTumichChAmi te rUpamaishvaraM puruShottama .. 11-3 ..

sanskrit: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो । योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् ॥ ११-४ ॥
translation: So, it is as Thou hast declared Thyself; I wish to see Thy Lordly form, O Purushottama, omnipotent Lord; if Thou thinkest it is possible for me to see that, O Lord of yogas, then show Thou unto me Thy immutable Self.
itrans: manyase yadi tachChakyaM mayA draShTumiti prabho . yogeshvara tato me tva.n darshayAtmAnamavyayam .. 11-4 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः । नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ॥ ११-५ ॥
translation: The blessed Lord said: Behold, O Partha, My forms by hundreds and thousands, of very many kinds, divine of various colours and shapes.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . pashya me pArtha rUpANi shatasho.atha sahasrashaH . nAnAvidhAni divyAni nAnAvarNAkR^itIni cha .. 11-5 ..

sanskrit: पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा । बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत ॥ ११-६ ॥
translation: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the two Asvins and the Maruts, behold, O Bharata, many marvels never seen ere this.
itrans: pashyAdityAnvasUn.hrudrAnashvinau marutastathA . bahUnyadR^iShTapUrvANi pashyAshcharyANi bhArata .. 11-6 ..

sanskrit: इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् । मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि ॥ ११-७ ॥
translation: Here, in My body, behold to-day all the world with the moving and unmoving standing together in one place, O Gudakesa; and (behold) what else thou desirest to see.
itrans: ihaikastha.n jagatkR^itsnaM pashyAdya sacharAcharam . mama dehe guDAkesha yachchAnyad draShTumichChasi .. 11-7 ..

sanskrit: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा । दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ॥ ११-८ ॥
translation: But thou art not able to see Me with this very eye of thine; (therefore) I give unto thee the divine eye. “Behold My Lordly Yoga.” V. (5) Though Arjuna says, "I wish to see Thy form," it might appear that he wished to see but one form, still the plurality of forms he is asked to see, implies that it is also meant by him. Further it implies that the same one essence of the Lord, immutable as it is, by virtue of a peculiar power may present countless forms, which. Arjuna collectively denotes by the singular word. (7) Here, in My body which is about to be revealed to thee.
itrans: na tu mA.n shakyase draShTumanenaiva svachakShuShA . divya.n dadAmi te chakShuH pashya me yogamaishvaram .. 11-8 ..

sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः । दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम् ॥ ११-९ ॥
translation: Sanjaya said: Having thus spoken, O monarch, Hari, the Lord of great yogas, then showed to Partha His supreme form as Lord.
itrans: sa~njaya uvAcha . evamuktvA tato rAjanmahAyogeshvaro hariH . darshayAmAsa pArthAya paramaM rUpamaishvaram .. 11-9 ..

sanskrit: अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् । अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ॥ ११-१० ॥
itrans: anekavaktranayanamanekAd.hbhutadarshanam . anekadivyAbharaNaM divyAnekodyatAyudham .. 11-10 ..

sanskrit: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् । सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् ॥ ११-११ ॥
translation: The form with many mouths and eyes, in which many marvels are seen, with many divine ornaments, with many up-raised divine weapons (10), wearing divine wreaths and vestments, anointed with divine pigments, the embodiment of all marvels, brilliant, boundless, with face turned everywhere:
itrans: divyamAlyAmbaradharaM divyagandhAnulepanam . sarvAshcharyamayaM devamanantaM vishvatomukham .. 11-11 ..

sanskrit: दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता । यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥ ११-१२ ॥
translation: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out at once in the sky, that might resemble the glory of Him who is of the universe form
itrans: divi sUryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitA . yadi bhAH sadR^ishI sA syAdbhAsastasya mahAtmanaH .. 11-12 ..

sanskrit: तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा । अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा ॥ ११-१३ ॥
translation: There the Pandava then beheld the whole world of distinct things standing together in the body of the Deity of deities.
itrans: tatraikastha.n jagatkR^itsnaM pravibhaktamanekadhA . apashyaddevadevasya sharIre pANDavastadA .. 11-13 ..

sanskrit: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ॥ ११-१४ ॥
translation: Then he, Dhananjaya, overwhelmed with astonishment, his hair upstanding, bowed down his head to the Lord, and with joined hands spoke.
itrans: tataH sa vismayAviShTo hR^iShTaromA dhana~njayaH . praNamya shirasA devaM kR^itA~njalirabhAShata .. 11-14 ..

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे        सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान् । ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ-        मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान् ॥ ११-१५ ॥
translation: I behold all the gods, O Lord, in Thy body and all the various classes of beings; Brahma the four-faced, and Rudra in Kamalasana (Brahma); and the Rishis all and serpents the wonderful.;
itrans: arjuna uvAcha . pashyAmi devA.nstava deva dehe        sarvA.nstathA bhUtavisheShasa~NghAn . brahmANamIshaM kamalAsanastha-        mR^iShI.nshcha sarvAnuragA.nshcha divyAn .. 11-15 ..

sanskrit: अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं        पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् । नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं        पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर  विश्वरूप ॥ ११-१६ ॥
translation: I behold Thee with countless arms; breasts, faces and eyes, I see Thee everywhere to be of infinite forms; neither the end nor the middle nor the beginning do I see, of Thee, O the Lord of all of perfect form.
itrans: anekabAhUdaravaktranetra.n        pashyAmi tvA.n sarvato.anantarUpam . nAntaM na madhyaM na punastavAdi.n        pashyAmi vishveshvara  vishvarUpa .. 11-16 ..

sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च        तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् । पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद्        दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम् ॥ ११-१७ ॥
translation:
With diadem, mace, and discus, mass of splendour, shining everywhere, Thee I behold-Thee dazzling the sight, radiant on all sides like the blazing fire and sun, (yet) unmeasurable. 
V. Yet unmeasurable: this epithet removes the idea of finiteness shadowed by the simile before it.
itrans: kirITinaM gadina.n chakriNa.n cha        tejorAshi.n sarvato dIptimantam . pashyAmi tvA.n durnirIkShya.n samantAd.h        dIptAnalArkadyutimaprameyam .. 11-17 ..

sanskrit: त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं        त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् । त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता        सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ॥ ११-१८ ॥
translation: Thou art the supreme Akshara, the supreme object of knowledge. Thou art of this universe the highest support; Thou art changeless, the guardian of the eternal Dharma (virtue); Thou art the eternal Purusha; Thou art concluded (as such) by me.
itrans: tvamakSharaM paramaM veditavya.n        tvamasya vishvasya paraM nidhAnam . tvamavyayaH shAshvatadharmagoptA        sanAtanastvaM puruSho mato me .. 11-18 ..

sanskrit: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-        मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् । पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं        स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् ॥ ११-१९ ॥
translation: Thee destitute of beginning, middle or end, of infinite force, of infinite hands, with the sun and moon for Thine eyes, whose mouth is the blazing fire, who burnest this universe with Thine own splendour – Thee I behold.
itrans: anAdimadhyAntamanantavIrya-        manantabAhu.n shashisUryanetram . pashyAmi tvA.n dIptahutAshavaktra.n        svatejasA vishvamidaM tapantam .. 11-19 ..

sanskrit: द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि        व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः । दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं        लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ॥ ११-२० ॥
translation: This space between heaven and earth is filled by Thee with one form; and all these directions (are filled with other forms of Thine), seeing this Wonderful, awful form of Thine, O Mahâtman the three worlds are deeply troubled (cast in fear).
itrans: dyAvApR^ithivyoridamantara.n hi        vyApta.n tvayaikena dishashcha sarvAH . dR^iShTvAd.hbhutaM rUpamugra.n tavedaM        lokatrayaM pravyathitaM mahAtman .. 11-20 ..

sanskrit: अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घा विशन्ति        केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति । स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः        स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ॥ ११-२१ ॥
translation: These throngs of gods indeed enter Thee; some afraid with joined hands praise Thee; crying ‘all hail’ the multitudes of Maharshis and Siddhas sing Thee (fullest) praises pregnant (with) Thy excellent qualities.
itrans: amI hi tvA.n surasa~NghA vishanti        kechidbhItAH prA~njalayo gR^iNanti . svastItyuktvA maharShisiddhasa~NghAH        stuvanti tvA.n stutibhiH puShkalAbhiH .. 11-21 ..

sanskrit: रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या        विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च । गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा        वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ॥ ११-२२ ॥
translation: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, and those who are called Sadhyas, Visvedevas, the two Aswins and the Maruts and the Pitris; the thronging Gandharvas Yakshas, Asuras, Siddhas, behold Thee all immersed in wonder and in wonder only.
itrans: rudrAdityA vasavo ye cha sAdhyA        vishve.ashvinau marutashchoShmapAshcha . gandharvayakShAsurasiddhasa~NghA        vIkShante tvA.n vismitAshchaiva sarve .. 11-22 ..

sanskrit: रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं        महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् । बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं        दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम् ॥ ११-२३ ॥
translation: Seeing Thy great form of many mouths and eyes, O Mighty-armed, of many arms, thighs and feet, of many breasts, terrific with fearful teeth, the worlds are terror-struck, as also am I.
itrans: rUpaM mahatte bahuvaktranetra.n        mahAbAho bahubAhUrupAdam . bahUdaraM bahuda.nShTrAkarAlaM        dR^iShTvA lokAH pravyathitAstathAham .. 11-23 ..

sanskrit: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं        व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् । दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा        धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥ ११-२४ ॥
translation: Thee, touching heaven, blazing, of many hues, with open mouth, and shining vast-orbed eyes, having seen Thee, agitated in mind, I do not find my strength or peace, O Vishnu.
itrans: nabhaHspR^ishaM dIptamanekavarNa.n        vyAttAnanaM dIptavishAlanetram . dR^iShTvA hi tvAM pravyathitAntarAtmA        dhR^iti.n na vindAmi shama.n cha viShNo .. 11-24 ..

sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि        दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि । दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म        प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥ ११-२५ ॥
translation: Having just seen Thy mouths terrific with fearful teeth, resembling the flames of Pralaya-time. I do not see the directions nor find peace of mind; be merciful, O Ruler of the gods, the abode of the world.
itrans: da.nShTrAkarAlAni cha te mukhAni        dR^iShTvaiva kAlAnalasannibhAni . disho na jAne na labhe cha sharma        prasIda devesha jagannivAsa .. 11-25 ..

sanskrit: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः        सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः । भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ        सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥ ११-२६ ॥
translation: And these sons of Dhritarashtra, all with the multitudes of princes of earth, Bhishma, Drona and this Karna also along with the foremost warriors on our side too
itrans: amI cha tvA.n dhR^itarAShTrasya putrAH        sarve sahaivAvanipAlasa~NghaiH . bhIShmo droNaH sUtaputrastathAsau        sahAsmadIyairapi yodhamukhyaiH .. 11-26 ..

sanskrit: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति        दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि । केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु        सन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः ॥ ११-२७ ॥
translation: Hasten to enter into Thy mouths of tremendous teeth and of terrific appearance; some are seen, caught in the gaps between (Thy) teeth, their heads crushed to powder.
itrans: vaktrANi te tvaramANA vishanti        da.nShTrAkarAlAni bhayAnakAni . kechidvilagnA dashanAntareShu        sandR^ishyante chUrNitairuttamA~NgaiH .. 11-27 ..

sanskrit: यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः        समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति । तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा        विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति ॥ ११-२८ ॥
translation: Just as the numerous currents of water of rivers run towards the sea alone, so do these warriors of the mortal world enter the flaming mouths of Thine.
itrans: yathA nadInAM bahavo.ambuvegAH        samudramevAbhimukhA dravanti . tathA tavAmI naralokavIrA        vishanti vaktrANyabhivijvalanti .. 11-28 ..

sanskrit: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा        विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः । तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास्-        तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः ॥ ११-२९ ॥
translation: Just as to the blazing fire moths run with increasing rapidity, so also these enter into Thy mouths for their own destruction.
itrans: yathA pradIpta.n jvalanaM pata~NgA        vishanti nAshAya samR^iddhavegAH . tathaiva nAshAya vishanti lokAs-        tavApi vaktrANi samR^iddhavegAH .. 11-29 ..

sanskrit: लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्-        लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः । तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं        भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो ॥ ११-३० ॥
translation: On every side swallowing all the worlds with Thy fiery tongue Thou lappest (them); Thy terrible rays fill the whole world with light and make it warm, O Vishnu.
itrans: lelihyase grasamAnaH samantAl.h-        lokAnsamagrAnvadanairjvaladbhiH . tejobhirApUrya jagatsamagra.n        bhAsastavogrAH pratapanti viShNo .. 11-30 ..

sanskrit: आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो        नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद । विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं        न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् ॥ ११-३१ ॥
translation: Pray, tell me: Who art Thou of terrible form? Bow to Thee, have mercy, the foremost Deity; "Thee the first of all I wish to understand well, for I do not understand Thy course.
itrans: AkhyAhi me ko bhavAnugrarUpo        namo.astu te devavara prasIda . vij~nAtumichChAmi bhavantamAdya.n        na hi prajAnAmi tava pravR^ittim .. 11-31 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो        लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः । ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे        येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥ ११-३२ ॥
translation: The blessed Lord said: I am Kala, the destroyer of the world, perfect and all-pervading; to destroy these people I have come here, except thee all these will cease to be, viz., the warriors who are arrayed in the opposing armies.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . kAlo.asmi lokakShayakR^itpravR^iddho        lokAnsamAhartumiha pravR^ittaH . R^ite.api tvA.n na bhaviShyanti sarve        ye.avasthitAH pratyanIkeShu yodhAH .. 11-32 ..

sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व        जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् । मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव        निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ॥ ११-३३ ॥
translation: Therefore, do thou stand up, obtain glory conquering the enemies, enjoy the prosperous realm; by Myself they are already killed; be thou the nominal cause, O Savyasâchin. V. Already killed: almost killed; for, their life-time has been cut short by Me. Thou wilt be the outward means of killing them. Even through Thee I am going to destroy them.
itrans: tasmAttvamuttiShTha yasho labhasva        jitvA shatrUn bhu~N.hkShva rAjya.n samR^iddham . mayaivaite nihatAH pUrvameva        nimittamAtraM bhava savyasAchin .. 11-33 ..

sanskrit: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च        कर्णं तथान्यानपि योधवीरान् । मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा        युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान् ॥ ११-३४ ॥
translation:
Drona and Bhishma and Jayadratha and Karna and so also the other warrior chiefs, slay these already slain by Me; let there be no trouble (in thy heart); fight, thou shalt conquer the foes in battle. (37.) 
A. Sanjaya anticipates Dhritarashtra and tells him what happened.
itrans: droNa.n cha bhIShma.n cha jayadratha.n cha        karNa.n tathAnyAnapi yodhavIrAn . mayA hatA.nstva.n jahi mA vyathiShThA        yudhyasva jetAsi raNe sapatnAn .. 11-34 ..

sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच । एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य        कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी । नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं        सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य ॥ ११-३५ ॥
translation: Sanjaya said: Having heard this word of Krishna with joined hands; Kiriti, trembling, bowed down again, spoke to Krishna in a faltering voice, very much terrified and bowing.
itrans: sa~njaya uvAcha . etachChrutvA vachanaM keshavasya        kR^itA~njalirvepamAnaH kirITI . namaskR^itvA bhUya evAha kR^iShNaM        sagadgadaM bhItabhItaH praNamya .. 11-35 ..

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या        जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च । रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति        सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः ॥ ११-३६ ॥
translation: Arjuna said. It is just, O Hrishikésa, that with Thy great glory the world is delighted and becomes devoted (to Thee); the evil spirits being afraid run in all directions and the throngs of Siddhas are all worshipping Thee.
itrans: arjuna uvAcha . sthAne hR^iShIkesha tava prakIrtyA        jagatprahR^iShyatyanurajyate cha . rakShA.nsi bhItAni disho dravanti        sarve namasyanti cha siddhasa~NghAH .. 11-36 ..

sanskrit: कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्        गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे । अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास        त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् ॥ ११-३७ ॥
translation: And why should they not bow to Thee, O perfect Lord-Thee, the most exalted, the first Maker even of Brahma; Infinite, God of gods, the abiding place of the world; Thou art the Akshara (imperishable) which is far higher than the world of Sat and Asat.
itrans: kasmAchcha te na nameranmahAtman.h        garIyase brahmaNo.apyAdikartre . ananta devesha jagannivAsa        tvamakSharaM sadasattatparaM yat .. 11-37 ..

sanskrit: त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणस्-        त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् । वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम        त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप ॥ ११-३८ ॥
translation: Thou art the first of the gods, the ancient person; Thou art the highest support of this universe. Thou art the perfect Knower, what ought to be known, the highest effulgence. By Thee is pervaded the universe, O one of unlimited essence.
itrans: tvamAdidevaH puruShaH purANas-        tvamasya vishvasya paraM nidhAnam . vettAsi vedya.n cha para.n cha dhAma        tvayA tataM vishvamanantarUpa .. 11-38 ..

sanskrit: वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः        प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च । नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः        पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते ॥ ११-३९ ॥
translation: Thou art Vayu and Yama, Agni, Varuna, Sasanka, Prajapati; and Thou art the grandsire. Bow to Thee a thousand times again and again; again, and again I bow to Thee.
itrans: vAyuryamo.agnirvaruNaH shashA~NkaH        prajApatistvaM prapitAmahashcha . namo namaste.astu sahasrakR^itvaH        punashcha bhUyo.api namo namaste .. 11-39 ..

sanskrit: नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते        नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व । अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं        सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः ॥ ११-४० ॥
translation: Bow to Thee before and behind; and bow to Thee on all sides, O Perfect One; Thou art infinite force and immeasurable prowess; because Thou pervadest everything, therefore Thou art All.
itrans: namaH purastAdatha pR^iShThataste        namo.astu te sarvata eva sarva . anantavIryAmitavikramastva.n        sarva.n samApnoShi tato.asi sarvaH .. 11-40 ..

sanskrit: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं        हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति । अजानता महिमानं तवेदं        मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ॥ ११-४१ ॥
translation: Thinking Thee but a friend, what might have been said without reverence calling Thee, 'O Krishna, Yadava, O friend, by me not knowing Thy glory, this error from carelessness or even through love.
itrans: sakheti matvA prasabhaM yaduktaM        he kR^iShNa he yAdava he sakheti . ajAnatA mahimAnaM tavedaM        mayA pramAdAtpraNayena vApi .. 11-41 ..

sanskrit: यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि        विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु । एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं        तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम् ॥ ११-४२ ॥
translation: And what irreverence Thou hast been shown for the sake of fun, at play, in bed and seat, or at meals, supreme as Thou art, O Achyuta, all that I directly pray to Thee, the immeasurable, to pardon in me.
itrans: yachchAvahAsArthamasatkR^ito.asi        vihArashayyAsanabhojaneShu . eko.athavApyachyuta tatsamakSha.n        tatkShAmaye tvAmahamaprameyam .. 11-42 ..

sanskrit: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य        त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् । न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो        लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव ॥ ११-४३ ॥
translation: Father Thou art of the world that moves and stands; Thou art the worshipful and supreme Preceptor of this world, there is none equal to Thee. Whence could there be another that surpasseth Thee? O Thou of matchless glory in all the three worlds.
itrans: pitAsi lokasya charAcharasya        tvamasya pUjyashcha gururgarIyAn . na tvatsamo.astyabhyadhikaH kuto.anyo        lokatraye.apyapratimaprabhAva .. 11-43 ..

sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं        प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम् । पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः        प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् ॥ ११-४४ ॥
translation: Therefore, I bow to Thee laying my body prostrate; I pray to Thee, the Ruler, the praiseworthy, for Thy favour; may Thou be pleased to bear with me as father with the son, friend with friend, and lover with the beloved.
itrans: tasmAtpraNamya praNidhAya kAyaM        prasAdaye tvAmahamIshamIDyam . piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuH        priyaH priyAyArhasi deva soDhum .. 11-44 ..

sanskrit: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा        भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे । तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं        प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥ ११-४५ ॥
translation: I am rejoiced at having seen what was never seen before and my heart too shakes with fear, the very same form of Thine, O sportful Lord, show unto me; be pleased with me, O God of gods, the support of the universe.
itrans: adR^iShTapUrva.n hR^iShito.asmi dR^iShTvA        bhayena cha pravyathitaM mano me . tadeva me darshaya deva rUpaM        prasIda devesha jagannivAsa .. 11-45 ..

sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तं        इच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव । तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन        सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते ॥ ११-४६ ॥
translation: Thee wearing diadem with Gada and discus in the hand, I wish to see as before; pray, Thou be in the same form with four arms, thousand-armed, O Perfect One, to whom everything is like unto a body.
itrans: kirITinaM gadina.n chakrahastaM        ichChAmi tvA.n draShTumahaM tathaiva . tenaiva rUpeNa chaturbhujena        sahasrabAho bhava vishvamUrte .. 11-46 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं        रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् । तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं        यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् ॥ ११-४७ ॥
translation: The Blessed Lord said: By Me, graciously has been shown to thee, by My own will and power, this supreme form, O Arjuna; it is the embodiment of radiance, perfect, unlimited by time and space, the first of all, which form of Mine by any other than thyself was not seen before.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . mayA prasannena tavArjunedaM        rUpaM paraM darshitamAtmayogAt . tejomayaM vishvamanantamAdya.n        yanme tvadanyena na dR^iShTapUrvam .. 11-47 ..

sanskrit: न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानैर्-        न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः । एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके        द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर ॥ ११-४८ ॥
translation: Neither by the study of Vedas and sacrifices, nor by charitable gifts, nor by righteous works, nor by severe austerities, I of such form, am possible to be seen by any other than thyself, O warrior of Kuru race.
itrans: na vedayaj~nAdhyayanairna dAnair-        na cha kriyAbhirna tapobhirugraiH . eva.nrUpaH shakya ahaM nR^iloke        draShTuM tvadanyena kurupravIra .. 11-48 ..

sanskrit: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो        दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् । व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं        तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य ॥ ११-४९ ॥
translation: Be not troubled, be thou not bewildered, because thou hast beheld this, so fearful a form. Fearless and with a heart rejoiced do thou again freely behold this, the very same form of Mine (familiar to thee).
itrans: mA te vyathA mA cha vimUDhabhAvo        dR^iShTvA rUpaM ghoramIdR^i~N.hmamedam . vyapetabhIH prItamanAH punastva.n        tadeva me rUpamidaM prapashya .. 11-49 ..

sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच । इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा        स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः । आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं        भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ॥ ११-५० ॥
translation: Sanjaya said; Vasudeva being thus spoken to by Arjuna, again showed him His own form; and the perfect Lord, again becoming one of gentle form consoled the terrified one (Arjuna).
itrans: sa~njaya uvAcha . ityarjunaM vAsudevastathoktvA        svakaM rUpaM darshayAmAsa bhUyaH . AshvAsayAmAsa cha bhItamenaM        bhUtvA punaH saumyavapurmahAtmA .. 11-50 ..

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन । इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ॥ ११-५१ ॥
translation:
Arjuna said: Seeing this gentle, human form of Thine, O Janardana, I have now recovered my nature and feel comforted.
A. If it be asked why the awful form was displayed, the Lord tells him of the great importance of seeing the Visvarupa.
itrans: arjuna uvAcha . dR^iShTvedaM mAnuShaM rUpaM tava saumya.n janArdana . idAnImasmi sa.nvR^ittaH sachetAH prakR^iti.n gataH .. 11-51 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम । देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥ ११-५२ ॥
translation:
The blessed Lord said: This form which thou hast beheld, which even the gods are always eager to see (and have also seen), is very hard to see (59.)
V. Sudurdarsa: should be really taken as two words, viz., Sudarsa and Durdarsa meaning delightful to see and fearful and difficult to see. The idea is that for the devotees the sight is not only easily obtained, but also a delightful one. To others it is not only inaccessible, but the source of terror.
Since the sight of this form is sought after even by the gods and it has been necessary to make thee understand that thou art a nominal cause of the coming destruction, I conferred on thee such a vision.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . sudurdarshamidaM rUpaM dR^iShTavAnasi yanmama . devA apyasya rUpasya nitya.n darshanakA~NkShiNaH .. 11-52 ..

sanskrit: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया । शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ॥ ११-५३ ॥
translation: कNeither by the Vedas nor by austerity, nor by gift, nor by sacrificial eminence, I can be seen such as thou hast seen Me to be.
itrans: nAhaM vedairna tapasA na dAnena na chejyayA . shakya eva.nvidho draShTuM dR^iShTavAnasi mA.n yathA .. 11-53 ..

sanskrit: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन । ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप ॥ ११-५४ ॥
translation: But by Bhakti (devotion) unaided and withdrawn from all other things, I as such can be, O Arjun, truly known and seen and reached, O Parantapa.
itrans: bhaktyA tvananyayA shakya ahameva.nvidho.arjuna . j~nAtuM draShTu.n cha tattvena praveShTu.n cha parantapa .. 11-54 ..

sanskrit: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः । निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥ ११-५५ ॥
translation: He who doth duties to Me, to whom I am the Supreme Being, who is My devotee and destitute of attachment to fruits, who is no enemy to all beings, (to whom there is no enemy among all beings),- he cometh unto Me, O Pandava.
itrans: matkarmakR^inmatparamo madbhaktaH sa~NgavarjitaH . nirvairaH sarvabhUteShu yaH sa mAmeti pANDava .. 11-55 ..

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते । ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥ १२-१ ॥
translation: Arjuna said: Those that are always engaged in contemplation--the devotees who thus with faith worship Thee such, (of these and of) those who devoutly worship the imperishable Avyakta, which are the best that have known Yoga?
itrans: arjuna uvAcha . evaM satatayuktA ye bhaktAstvAM paryupAsate . ye chApyakSharamavyaktaM teShA.n ke yogavittamAH .. 12-1 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते । श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥ १२-२ ॥
translation: The blessed Lord said: They who wholly fixing their mind upon Me, worship Me ever practising Yoga, with perfect faith, they are considered by Me the foremost among those that are endowed with Yoga. V. Ever practising Yoga: ever discharging the duties without any attachment to the consequences, and also deeply contemplating the Lord, which twofold Yoga is meant here. Among.... Yoga: among those that are following the course of duty and contemplation for the sake of Moksha.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . mayyAveshya mano ye mAM nityayuktA upAsate . shraddhayA parayopetAH te me yuktatamA matAH .. 12-2 ..

sanskrit: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते । सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यञ्च कूटस्थमचलन्ध्रुवम् ॥ १२-३ ॥
translation: They, however, who devoutly worship Avyakta, the imperishable, impossible to define fully, present everywhere and incomprehensible, unmoving, presiding over space and unchanging, and eternal;
itrans: ye tvakSharamanirdeshyamavyaktaM paryupAsate . sarvatragamachintya~ncha kUTasthamachalandhruvam .. 12-3 ..

sanskrit: सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः । ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥ १२-४ ॥
translation: They who restraining all the senses with equally correct understanding of all things (worship such Avyakta), bent upon doing good to all beings (taking delight in what is beneficial to all beings), they surely come unto Me only.
itrans: sanniyamyendriyagrAmaM sarvatra samabuddhayaH . te prApnuvanti mAmeva sarvabhUtahite ratAH .. 12-4 ..

sanskrit: क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् । अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते ॥ १२-५ ॥
translation: Very, very great are the pains to be undergone by those whose mind is devoted to Avyakta, for the way through the worship of) Avyakta is hard to travel) for the embodied.
itrans: klesho.adhikatarasteShAmavyaktAsaktachetasAm . avyaktA hi gatirduHkha.n dehavadbhiravApyate .. 12-5 ..

sanskrit: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः । अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥ १२-६ ॥
translation: But they who reposing all their actions in Me, seeing Me the Supreme, worship Me contemplating, their contemplation not at all turned to another;
itrans: ye tu sarvANi karmANi mayi sa.nnyasya matparAH . ananyenaiva yogena mA.n dhyAyanta upAsate .. 12-6 ..

sanskrit: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् । भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ॥ १२-७ ॥
translation: Of them that have thoroughly given their mind to Me, I ere long become, O Partha, the protector from the ocean of life and death (birth and death).
itrans: teShAmahaM samuddhartA mR^ityusa.nsArasAgarAt . bhavAmi nachirAtpArtha mayyAveshitachetasAm .. 12-7 ..

sanskrit: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय । निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः ॥ १२-८ ॥
translation: On Me alone fix thy mind, in Mc let your reason abide; thereafter, no doubt, thou shalt live in Me alone.
itrans: mayyeva mana Adhatsva mayi buddhi.n niveshaya . nivasiShyasi mayyeva ata Urdhva.n na sa.nshayaH .. 12-8 ..

sanskrit: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् । अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय ॥ १२-९ ॥
translation: Or if thou canst not steadily fix thy mind on Me, seek then to reach Me by means of constant practice, O Dhananjaya.
itrans: atha chittaM samAdhAtuM na shaknoShi mayi sthiram . abhyAsayogena tato mAmichChAptuM dhana~njaya .. 12-9 ..

sanskrit: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव । मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ॥ १२-१० ॥
translation: If thou art not able constantly to practise even, be it thy chief thing (aim) to do duties towards Me; even (by doing duties for My sake) thou shalt obtain the reward (lit. what is sought after).
itrans: abhyAse.apyasamartho.asi matkarmaparamo bhava . madarthamapi karmANi kurvansiddhimavApsyasi .. 12-10 ..

sanskrit: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः । सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ॥ १२-११ ॥
translation: And if thou art unable to do this even, follow My yoga; then with the mind under control, do thou give up attachment to the fruits of all actions.
itrans: athaitadapyashakto.asi kartuM madyogamAshritaH . sarvakarmaphalatyAgaM tataH kuru yatAtmavAn .. 12-11 ..

sanskrit: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते । ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम् ॥ १२-१२ ॥
translation: Better indeed is wisdom than constant practice; Dhyana (contemplation) surpasses knowledge; than Dhyana, the renunciation of the fruit of action; than renunciation, (the direct realisation); then Peace.
itrans: shreyo hi j~nAnamabhyAsAjj~nAnAd.hdhyAnaM vishiShyate . dhyAnAtkarmaphalatyAgastyAgAchChAntiranantaram .. 12-12 ..

sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥ १२-१३ ॥
itrans: adveShTA sarvabhUtAnAM maitraH karuNa eva cha . nirmamo niraha~NkAraH samaduHkhasukhaH kShamI .. 12-13 ..

sanskrit: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः । मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥ १२-१४ ॥
translation: He who does not think evil to any being, who is friendly and full of compassion, without attachment and egoism, equal (possessing equanimity) under pleasure and pain, and is forgiving, even content and practising the yoga of duties and contemplation, with the mind restrained firm in conclusions, who with the mind and reason (Buddhi) entrusted to Me becomes My devotee, --- he is beloved of Me
itrans: santuShTaH satataM yogI yatAtmA dR^iDhanishchayaH . mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktaH sa me priyaH .. 12-14 ..

sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः । हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥ १२-१५ ॥
translation: And he of whom the world is not afraid, who is also not afraid of the world, and who is free from joy, anger, fear, and agitation of mind, he is beloved of Me.
itrans: yasmAnnodvijate loko lokAnnodvijate cha yaH . harShAmarShabhayodvegairmukto yaH sa cha me priyaH .. 12-15 ..

sanskrit: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः । सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥ १२-१६ ॥
translation: He who wants nothing, is pure, capable, indifferent, untroubled, renouncing every undertaking becomes My devotee, --he is beloved of Me.
itrans: anapekShaH shuchirdakSha udAsIno gatavyathaH . sarvArambhaparityAgI yo madbhaktaH sa me priyaH .. 12-16 ..

sanskrit: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति । शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः ॥ १२-१७ ॥
translation: He who neither loves nor hates, nor grieves nor desires, who renounces both the auspicious and the inauspicious, and is full of devotion to Me, he is beloved of Me.
itrans: yo na hR^iShyati na dveShTi na shochati na kA~NkShati . shubhAshubhaparityAgI bhaktimAnyaH sa me priyaH .. 12-17 ..

sanskrit: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः । शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ॥ १२-१८ ॥
translation: Equal to the friend and foe, also in honour and dishonour, the same under heat and cold, pleasure and pain, destitute of attachment.
itrans: samaH shatrau cha mitre cha tathA mAnApamAnayoH . shItoShNasukhaduHkheShu samaH sa~NgavivarjitaH .. 12-18 ..

sanskrit: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् । अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः ॥ १२-१९ ॥
translation: He for whom praise is equal to reproach, who being silent is satisfied with something or other, who without any fixed abode is of unshaken conclusions and full of devotion, that man is dear to Me.
itrans: tulyanindAstutirmaunI santuShTo yena kenachit . aniketaH sthiramatirbhaktimAnme priyo naraH .. 12-19 ..

sanskrit: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते । श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः ॥ १२-२० ॥
translation: Now those Bhaktas (devotees) who with faith earnestly adopt this course leading to Dharma and immortality as stated above, I being their supreme object, those devotees are most beloved of Me.
itrans: ye tu dharmyAmR^itamidaM yathoktaM paryupAsate . shraddadhAnA matparamA bhaktAste.atIva me priyAH .. 12-20 ..

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च । एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव ॥ १३-१ ॥
translation: Arjuna said: Prakriti and Purusha, Kshetra and Kshetragna as well, Gnana and Gneya, (all) this, O Kesava, I wish to understand.
itrans: arjuna uvAcha . prakR^itiM puruSha.n chaiva kShetra.n kShetraj~nameva cha . etadveditumichChAmi j~nAnaM j~neya.n cha keshava .. 13-1 ..

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते । एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥ १३-२ ॥
translation: This body, O Kaunteya, is called Kshetra; him that knows this they call Kshetragna- they that know it.
itrans: shrIbhagavAnuvAcha . idaM sharIraM kaunteya kShetramityabhidhIyate . etadyo vetti taM prAhuH kShetraj~na iti tadvidaH .. 13-2 ..

sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत । क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम ॥ १३-३ ॥
translation: And know Me alone as Kshetragna in all Kshetras, O Bharata, the knowledge of Kshetra and Kshetragna is concluded to be the knowledge of Me.
itrans: kShetraj~na.n chApi mAM viddhi sarvakShetreShu bhArata . kShetrakShetraj~nayorj~nAnaM yattajj~nAnaM mataM mama .. 13-3 ..

sanskrit: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् । स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु ॥ १३-४ ॥
translation: What is that Kshetra, what properties it has, what is it the modification of, and from whom it derives its Activity (impulse), who He is, of what great power He is, -(all) this briefly hear from Me. V. That Kshetra: which has been so called on account of the Almighty dwelling therein, which has been also called Sarira, on account of its being the source of trial and suffering through the corporeal body, its effect. Yat (going) at the end of the first half, is the present participle from the root i.e., to go. Who He is: He, the impeller.
itrans: tatkShetra.n yachcha yAdR^ikcha yadvikAri yatashcha yat . sa cha yo yatprabhAvashcha tatsamAsena me shR^iNu .. 13-4 ..

sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् । ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः ॥ १३-५ ॥
translation:
By Rishis it is sung in many ways; by the different Vedas also separately and thoroughly proved to be true; by the words of Brahma Sutras full of reasoning.
A. The first two questions are replied in the following.
itrans: R^iShibhirbahudhA gIta.n ChandobhirvividhaiH pR^ithak . brahmasUtrapadaishchaiva hetumadbhirvinishchitaiH .. 13-5 ..

sanskrit: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च । इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ॥ १३-६ ॥
translation: The great Bhutas (elements), Ahankâra, Budddhi and also Avyakta; the organs one and ten, and the five objects of sense. V. The great elements: the well-known five: ether, air, fire, water, and earth, Ahankara: also implies Mahattatva. Both these are principles of matter next in order to the three Gunas. Buddhi: a special inner faculty. Avyakta: the root principle of matter composed of Satva, Rajas and Tamas. The organs are ten, five of sense and five of action; and the one is Manas or the mind, the master-sense. The five objects of sense: sound, touch, colour, taste and smell. The Bhuta, &c. should be taken as class names counting different communities of attributes. That is, the terms are so chosen as to convey the essential attributes of the things along with their denotation. In ordinary language these terms name the things and also tell us what their peculiarities are.
itrans: mahAbhUtAnyaha~NkAro buddhiravyaktameva cha . indriyANi dashaika.n cha pa~ncha chendriyagocharAH .. 13-6 ..

sanskrit: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतना धृतिः । एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् ॥ १३-७ ॥
translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure and pain, the body, intellectual pervasion, courage: now this Kshetra, is briefly described along with its Vikaras or modifications.
itrans: ichChA dveShaH sukhaM duHkhaM sa~NghAtashchetanA dhR^itiH . etatkShetra.n samAsena savikAramudAhR^itam .. 13-7 ..

sanskrit: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् । आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥ १३-८ ॥
translation: Absence of self-praise, absence of pretentiousness, harmlessness, forbearance, straightforwardness, service of preceptors, purity, Steadfastness, especially restraint of mind.
itrans: amAnitvamadambhitvamahi.nsA kShAntirArjavam . AchAryopAsanaM shauchaM sthairyamAtmavinigrahaH .. 13-8 ..

sanskrit: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च । जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ॥ १३-९ ॥
translation: Absence of attachment to the objects of sense, absence of pride, constant perception of the misery and evil of birth, death, old age and disease.
itrans: indriyArtheShu vairAgyamanaha~NkAra eva cha . janmamR^ityujarAvyAdhiduHkhadoShAnudarshanam .. 13-9 ..

sanskrit: असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु । नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु ॥ १३-१० ॥
translation: Absence of attachment, absence of intense attachment to sons, wives, houses and other things; on the coming of the desirable and the undesirable, to regard then always equally;
itrans: asaktiranabhiShva~NgaH putradAragR^ihAdiShu . nitya.n cha samachittatvamiShTAniShTopapattiShu .. 13-10 ..

sanskrit: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी । विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥ १३-११ ॥
translation: And devotion to Me, which, not directed to any other, is unswerving; dwelling in a secluded and holy spot; absence of delight in the society of people.
itrans: mayi chAnanyayogena bhaktiravyabhichAriNI . viviktadeshasevitvamaratirjanasa.nsadi .. 13-11 ..

sanskrit: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् । एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा ॥ १३-१२ ॥
translation: To be always bent upon the knowledge of Atman, to inquire into Sâstras leading to direct realisation; this, it is said, is knowledge; what is other than this is no knowledge,
itrans: adhyAtmaj~nAnanityatva.n tattvaj~nAnArthadarshanam . etajj~nAnamiti proktamaj~nAnaM yadato.anyathA .. 13-12 ..

sanskrit: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते । अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ॥ १३-१३ ॥
translation: What I shall declare as the thing to be known, having known which one attains Moksha (immortality), is the perfect Brahman, destitute of all that has a beginning"; it is called neither Sat nor Asat.
itrans: j~neyaM yattatpravakShyAmi yajj~nAtvAmR^itamashnute . anAdimatparaM brahma na sattannAsaduchyate .. 13-13 ..

sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् । सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥ १३-१४ ॥
translation: Everywhere it has hand and foot; everywhere it has the eye, head, and face; everywhere it has the car; it remains encompassing all in the world.
itrans: sarvataH pANipAdaM tatsarvato.akShishiromukham . sarvataH shrutimalloke sarvamAvR^itya tiShThati .. 13-14 ..

sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् । असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥ १३-१५ ॥
translation: It illuminates the powers of all the senses; it is destitute of all the organs (formed of Prakriti), it is unaffected, it enjoys everything (devours everything), [it supports everything], it is without qualities (of Prakriti); and it enjoys all excellence (i.e., all excellent qualities.)
itrans: sarvendriyaguNAbhAsaM sarvendriyavivarjitam . asakta.n sarvabhR^ichchaiva nirguNaM guNabhoktR^i cha .. 13-15 ..

sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च । सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥ १३-१६ ॥
translation: It is inside and outside all beings; it is unmoving as well as moving; being very subtle it is incomprehensible; it remains far and near.
itrans: bahirantashcha bhUtAnAmachara.n charameva cha . sUkShmatvAttadavij~neyaM dUrastha.n chAntike cha tat .. 13-16 ..

sanskrit: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् । भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥ १३-१७ ॥
translation: Undivided it is in all the separate beings as if it were a divisible thing; it is the support of beings, it is the swallower and the producer. It is to be known as (such).
itrans: avibhakta.n cha bhUteShu vibhaktamiva cha sthitam . bhUtabhartR^i cha tajj~neyaM grasiShNu prabhaviShNu cha .. 13-17 ..

sanskrit: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते । ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥ १३-१८ ॥
translation: It is also called the light of lights; one that is beyond Tamas, wisdom, the known, the goal of knowledge, and it is seated in the heart of all.
itrans: jyotiShAmapi tajjyotistamasaH paramuchyate . j~nAnaM j~neyaM j~nAnagamya.n hR^idi sarvasya viShThitam .. 13-18 ..

sanskrit: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः । मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥ १३-१९ ॥
translation: Thus, Kshetra as well as Knowledge and the Thing to be known have been briefly declared; My devotee having well understood this becomes fit to take his stand on Me.
itrans: iti kShetra.n tathA j~nAnaM j~neya.n chokta.n samAsataH . madbhakta etadvij~nAya madbhAvAyopapadyate .. 13-19 ..

sanskrit: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि । विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान् ॥ १३-२० ॥
translation: Prakriti and Purusha, know both these to be destitute of beginning. Know thou the modifications and qualities to be born of Prakriti
itrans: prakR^itiM puruSha.n chaiva vid.hdhyanAdI ubhAvapi . vikArA.nshcha guNA.nshchaiva viddhi prakR^itisambhavAn .. 13-20 ..

sanskrit: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते । पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते ॥ १३-२१ ॥
translation: Prakriti is declared to be the cause, the effect. (the body), the instruments (the organs), the agentship (in the soul). And Purusha is declared the cause of the soul's experiencing pleasures and pains.
itrans: kAryakAraNakartR^itve hetuH prakR^itiruchyate . puruShaH sukhaduHkhAnAM bhoktR^itve heturuchyate .. 13-21 ..

sanskrit: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् । कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ॥ १३-२२ ॥
translation: Purusha (Jiva) standing in Prakriti indeed experiences the qualities or the results proceeding from Prakriti; the attachment to the qualities (Satva, Rajas and Tamas) is the cause for his going through births in good and evil wombs.
itrans: puruShaH prakR^itistho hi bhu~N.hkte prakR^itijAnguNAn . kAraNaM guNasa~Ngo.asya sadasadyonijanmasu .. 13-22 ..

sanskrit: उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः । परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः ॥ १३-२३ ॥
translation: Paramatman (the supreme intelligence), the omnipotent Lord, is the Providence that impels, the most exalted witness, the support, enjoying the good essence of all action; so, He is called Purusha and He is even declared to be in this body and is far different (from it).
itrans: upadraShTAnumantA cha bhartA bhoktA maheshvaraH . paramAtmeti chApyukto dehe.asminpuruShaH paraH .. 13-23 ..

sanskrit: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह । सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते ॥ १३-२४ ॥
translation: He who knows this Purusha and Prakriti together with their characteristics, in whatever state he may be, --he is not born again.
itrans: ya evaM vetti puruShaM prakR^iti.n cha guNaiH saha . sarvathA vartamAno.api na sa bhUyo.abhijAyate .. 13-24 ..
